_comment: Vanilla Finest setup screen texts. Copy this file to config/vanilla-finest-helper/setup/ (or <language>.json, e.g. hu_hu.json) to change the wording; a copy only needs the texts it changes. %s is filled in by the game, {key:<key binding id>} becomes the key's current name.
welcome.missing:
## No welcome text yet

This page shows the modpack's own welcome text, which is not part of the mod. To add one, create **welcome.md** in this folder of the instance:

> %s

Write it in Markdown: # and ## headings, - lists, **bold**, *italic* and [links](https://modrinth.com). For another language add **welcome.<language>.md** as well (for example welcome.hu_hu.md). Link buttons under the text (up to four) go in **en_us.json** in the same folder, as welcome.links. Reopen this screen to see the change.
settings.languages.one: Menus and texts: §e%s§r. You can add more languages: inventory search then works in all of them.
settings.languages.added: %s was added because your computer uses it.
settings.keymap.tooltip: Every key binding on a picture of the keyboard.
settings.voxy.tooltip: Voxy draws the land far beyond the render distance. Applied with ✔.
settings.voxy.vulkan: Voxy only works with OpenGL. Choose OpenGL and restart the game to use it.
settings.guiscale.tooltip: Far left is Automatic: the size follows the window. Changed when you let go of the slider.
settings.renderdistance.locked: With Voxy on, the render distance stays at 16 and Voxy draws the land beyond it.
settings.graphics.hint: Vulkan is faster but turns Voxy off (needs a restart). With Voxy on, the render distance stays at 16 and Voxy draws the land beyond it. GUI Scale: far left is Automatic.
folders.preset.modpack.tooltip: Each mod's own folder inside this modpack.
folders.preset.desktop.tooltip: A Minecraft folder on your desktop.
folders.preset.documents.tooltip: A Minecraft folder in your Documents.
folders.box.title: Good to know
folders.hint.1: Modpack keeps your files in this modpack's own folder: they are deleted together with this instance.
folders.hint.2: Minecraft, Desktop or Documents: one shared folder that every Vanilla Finest version, and the official launcher, finds.
folders.hint.3: A folder set in a mod's own settings shows up here. Change… picks one folder; saved files are not moved.
folders.onedrive: This folder is inside OneDrive: everything saved there is uploaded and uses your OneDrive space.
folders.none: None of the folder mods are installed.
folders.restart: Axiom uses the new folder after a restart.
